race.description: Jb Is A Legend Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BUTTERCUP (7) has found the maiden win elusive but profiles strongly second-up after a strong chase into the placing when resuming at Eagle Farm in mid-week company. With improvement to come and an inside draw she's clearly the one to beat. MAGIC INVADER (4) is hard to dismiss on consistency, although his long maiden record and wide alley tempers the win confidence slightly. TERRAX (5) resumes. Didn't show much in his only run last time in but his form back in Victoria reads well, and Thompson's booking keeps him firmly in calculations. Debutant FLASHING STAR (2) has trialled well in readiness and also deserves a watch, especially if there's market support.
